pool.text: Solve the exponential equation \( 2^{x+2} = 5^x \), giving \( x \) in terms of common logarithms.

pool.text: The function \( f(x) = \frac{3x + 1}{x - 2} \) is defined for \( x \ne 2 \). Find the inverse function \( f^{-1}(x) \).

pool.text: In the expansion of \( \left(1 + \frac{x}{2}\right)^n \), the coefficient of \( x^2 \) is twice the coefficient of \( x \). Given \( n > 0 \), what is the value of \( n \)?

pool.text: A particle moves in a straight line with acceleration \( a(t) = 6t - 8 \text{ m/s}^2 \). If it starts from rest at the origin (at \( t = 0 \)), at what time \( t > 0 \) does the particle momentarily come to rest again?
pool.sol: Velocity \( v(t) = \int (6t - 8)\,dt = 3t^2 - 8t + C \). Since \( v(0) = 0 \implies C = 0 \). Momentarily at rest when \( v(t) = 0 \implies t(3t - 8) = 0 \implies t = \frac{8}{3} \text{ s} \).
